# Vendored third-party code

## spectral.js

`spectral.min.js` — Kubelka-Munk pigment-mixing math (physically-plausible
paint mixing, spectral gradients). Vendored unmodified from
`spectral.js@3` (npm / jsDelivr), MIT licensed.

Copyright (c) 2025 Ronald van Wijnen
https://github.com/rvanwijnen/spectral.js

## brand-colors

`brand-colors.json` — community-collected brand color dataset (2,093 entries
across ~700 brands, keyed `brand`/`brand-2`/`brand-3`/...). Vendored
unmodified from `reimertz/brand-colors` (data/brandColors.json), MIT
licensed. **Last updated 2019** — see `data/brand-overrides.json` for a small
curated layer of post-2019 rebrands merged on top at load time. Brand colors
themselves aren't copyrightable; brand/trademark names are used only for
identification, not endorsement.

Copyright (c) 2016 Piérre Reimertz
https://github.com/reimertz/brand-colors
